Prepare checked numeric inputs for an experimental allocation workflow

Source: R/06-ae_workflow.R
prepare_allocation.Rd

Named axes align independently; unnamed axes are positional. Positive included demand enters facility-load support. Zero, unknown and explicitly excluded origins retain separate support statuses. This experimental entry point delegates to the existing compact preparation boundary.

Usage

prepare_allocation(
  demand,
  supply,
  distance,
  origin_ids = NULL,
  facility_ids = NULL,
  included = NULL,
  missing_demand = c("error", "exclude"),
  missing_travel = c("error", "legacy_zero"),
  spatial = NULL,
  metadata = list()
)

Arguments

demand

Numeric origin vector, finite and nonnegative or explicitly permitted missing values. Negative or infinite demand is rejected even on excluded origins. Named demand matches canonical origin IDs. For demand groups, a named list by group of such named vectors with identical name sets (any order); the group names must be unique, non-empty, not NA, not "all" and without ".". A matrix is refused.

supply

Finite nonnegative facility vector. Known zero supply is retained; unknown supply is rejected. Names match canonical facility IDs.

distance

Numeric origin-by-facility travel matrix. Complete named rows and columns match IDs independently; unnamed axes are positional. With demand groups, one matrix shared by the groups or a named list of matrices with one element per group, each aligned by origin and facility IDs. Missing travel for a group with zero demand at an origin is ignored.

origin_ids, facility_ids

Complete unique nonblank canonical IDs. Their order determines prepared order. The default (NULL) takes the names of the demand vector (of the first group for grouped demand) and the column names of the travel matrix; identities are never inferred from equal axis lengths.

included

Nonmissing logical origin mask (default: all TRUE). Names align independently; an unnamed mask follows supplied demand order (that of the first group for grouped demand) and is reordered with demand.

missing_demand

Default "error" rejects included missing demand. "exclude" omits it from loads while recording unknown demand, separately from known zero or explicit exclusion. Positive included demand remains active even when every inside edge is absent.

missing_travel

Default "error" rejects NA/NaN on active fit rows. "legacy_zero" explicitly omits unknown edges and records that policy. Finite nonnegative travel is known, positive infinity is an absent edge, and negative travel is invalid. Omitted rows are validated when requested by prediction. Model-specific finite domains, such as positive power distances, are checked when binding parameters; no imputation bypasses them.

spatial

Optional list with a one-layer terra::SpatRaster template and a complete unique in-range cell_index vector, optionally named by origin ID. Registry positions are not raster cells. Only plain geometry and the aligned mapping are saved. Numeric work needs no spatial metadata.

metadata

Optional named list of scalar strings or NA for demand_units, demand_period, supply_units, supply_period, and travel_units. Omitted fields remain NA. These are caller declarations; no unit conversion or dimensional compatibility check is performed.

Value

The existing ae_prepared_inputs, with a full origin registry and distinct support statuses plus compact active load arrays. No duplicate full travel matrix is retained. Pass it to clm_allocation() rather than editing its internal fields. Expected counts use demand units/period; proportional capacity attribution uses supply per unit of demand. With demand groups the total demand is D_active, and group_ids, D_groups and distance_groups are added (distance_active is NULL when travel is given per group).

Details

Demand groups (age bands, insurance types) are given as a named list of demand vectors, one per group, with the same origin IDs. An origin is active when it is included, every group demand is known and the total is positive; an origin with a group demand missing is unknown as a whole under missing_demand = "exclude". The prepared object then also carries the group IDs and the demand and travel by group (D_groups, distance_groups).

See also
